bearerAuth.description: JWT access token issued by AuthService.

ApiResponse.description: Standard response wrapper returned across AlgoPath REST endpoints.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request body, query parameter, or validation error.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication required or invalid JWT access token provided.

Forbidden.description: Access forbidden; insufficient roles/permissions or invalid internal secret.

NotFound.description: Requested entity or route not found.

Conflict.description: Request state conflicts with existing resource.

RateLimited.description: Rate limit exceeded. Retry after specified duration.
